description: Works out simple interest at 8% a year on an order for costs in England and Wales: from the date of the order (or acceptance of a Part 36 offer, or the date the court set) to the date you choose, allowing for payments on account, the County Court £5,000 rule and its exceptions, and leap years. It does not decide rates where the court has a discretion.

costs.description: The costs the interest is on: the assessed or agreed sum, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

crown.description: County Court: the costs are payable by the Crown, such as the MoD.

customStart.description: The court ordered interest to run from another date.

endDate.description: The date to calculate interest to (defaults to today) (YYYY-MM-DD).

orderDate.description: The date of that order or event (YYYY-MM-DD).

orderKind.description: What gave the right to costs: "assessed" (Order for costs to be assessed if not agreed), "stated" (Order for costs of a stated sum (summary assessment)), "p36-in-time" (Part 36 offer accepted within the relevant period, after the claim was issued), "p36-late" (Part 36 offer accepted late, and the court decided costs), "approval" (Settlement approved by the court (child or protected party)), "costs-only" (Order in costs-only proceedings (Part 8)), "other" (Another order or event).

otherSums.description: County Court: any other sums, such as damages, ordered in the same judgment, for the £5,000 test, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

payments.description: Payments on account, each with a date and an amount.

amount.description: Amount paid, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

startDate.description: Where customStart is true: the date interest runs from (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: calculate_interest_on_costs
title: Interest on costs calculator (Judgments Act 1838, 8%)
